author: feenberg
body:
I am reconsidering this.   I have since learned that Schedule C income is treated as a pass-through by QBID.  This makes psearn ssearn the same as pbusinc and sbusinc.  Can I ask of the four classes of income:

scorp
searn
businc
profinc

which are subject to QBI, QBI with phaseout, and FICA?  I ahve wanted to discuss this with Sabelhaus, or perhaps you know a tax lawyer who would talk to us.
